name: KBBI v6.1.0 Complete Word List (aryakdaniswara)
license: Not specified (data sourced from official KBBI v6.1.0 published by Badan Bahasa/Kemendikbud)
description: Clean single-column word list extracted from the official KBBI v6.1.0 (Kamus Besar Bahasa Indonesia Edisi Keenam). Ideal for spell-checking, autocomplete, and STT auto-correct dictionaries. This is the most recent KBBI edition. Direct curl/wget download.

name: KBBI v6.1.0 Full Dictionary Database with Definitions (Lyon28 / HuggingFace)
description: Full KBBI v6.1.0 dataset extracted from the KBBI web (kbbi.kemdikbud.go.id). Includes word, word class, definition, and example sentences. Useful for semantic/context-aware STT correction and homograph disambiguation. Mirror of damzaky/kumpulan-kata-bahasa-indonesia-KBBI on HuggingFace with structured CSV.
access_method: curl -L -o kbbi_full.csv 'https://huggingface.co/datasets/Lyon28/kamus-besar-bahasa-indonesia/resolve/main/data.csv'  (returns 302 redirect to HF CDN; -L follows it)

name: KBBI Word List from Official APK (damzaky)
license: Not specified (data obtained by reverse-engineering the official KBBI Android APK by Yuku)
description: Word list obtained by reverse-engineering the database file from the official KBBI Android app (yuku.kbbi5). This is the raw KBBI entries (no definitions). The 'legacy/' folder in the repo contains tweaked versions with manual additions. Compare with your existing 226K word dict to find missing entries.

name: Kamus Alay (Indonesian Slang Dictionary) - new_kamusalay.csv
license: Not specified in repo (widely cited dataset in Indonesian NLP research, OKKY Ibrohim)
description: The most widely-used Indonesian slang (bahasa alay/gaul) normalization dictionary. Maps informal/colloquial spellings to their formal KBBI equivalents (e.g. 'gk' -> 'tidak', 'bgt' -> 'banget', 'yg' -> 'yang'). Critical for STT auto-correction because spoken Indonesian is highly colloquial. Pairs perfectly with your existing _indoSlang dict.

name: IndoCollex - Formal/Informal Indonesian Word Pairs
license: ACL-IJCNLP 2021 research dataset (paper: IndoCollex, ACL Findings 2021) - cite paper if used
description: Annotated formal-to-informal Indonesian word transformation pairs categorized by transformation type (disemvowelling, affixation, shortening, sound alter, acronym, reverse, etc). Excellent for STT correction of colloquial speech. Includes transformation taxonomy so you can build rule-based correctors (e.g. 'kmrn' -> 'kemarin', 'blum' -> 'belum').

name: Sastrawi PHP - Indonesian Root Words (kata-dasar)
description: Indonesian root words (kata dasar) from the Sastrawi stemming library. These are base words WITHOUT inflections/prefixes/suffixes (e.g. 'makan' but not 'memakan', 'dimakan', 'termakan'). Useful for stemming-based STT correction - you can map inflected STT output to its root. Also available: kata-dasar.original.txt (30,342 words) which includes some non-KBBI entries.

name: Combined Indonesian NLP Resources (louisowen6)
format: TXT (3 combined files in repo root)
size_estimate: combined_root_words.txt: 249 KB / combined_slang_words.txt: 21 KB / combined_stop_words.txt: 6 KB
description: Curated combined Indonesian NLP dictionaries aggregated from multiple sources (Sastrawi, SentiStrengthID, ramaprakoso, agusmakmun, panggi/pujangga, etc). Three key files: combined_root_words.txt (deduplicated root words), combined_slang_words.txt (slang->formal pairs), combined_stop_words.txt (stopwords for filtering). One-stop-shop for STT correction vocab. Updated March 2022.

name: Data Wilayah Indonesia (hanifabd) - Provinces/Regencies/Districts/Villages
format: JSON (per-level files: provinsi.json, kabupaten/{code}.json, kecamatan/{code}.json, kelurahan/{code}.json)
license: Not specified (data sourced from BPS Badan Pusat Statistik and Kemendagri - government open data)
description: Comprehensive Indonesian administrative division data: provinces, kabupaten/kota, kecamatan, and kelurahan/desa with official codes. Essential for STT correction of place names (e.g. 'Yogyakarta', 'Sleman', 'Kalasan'). Updated April 2024 with latest data. Names are uppercase and contain proper Indonesian diacritics.

name: Indonesian Region Static API (emsifa) - with Postal Codes
entry_count: 38 provinces + 514 regencies + 7288 districts + 84210 villages + postal codes
description: Alternative to hanifabd - generates a static REST API with JSON files for all Indonesian administrative divisions INCLUDING postal codes. Hosted at emsifa.github.io/api-wilayah-indonesia so you can curl directly without git clone. Same source data (BPS/Kemendagri) but structured differently with nested API endpoints. Useful if you need postal code -> village mapping.
access_method: curl https://emsifa.github.io/api-wilayah-indonesia/api/provinces.json | jq .  (or git clone the repo to get all static files locally)

name: SATUSEHAT Glossary - Medical Terminology (Kemenkes)
license: Indonesian Government open data (Kementerian Kesehatan) - public information
description: Official medical terminology glossary from SATUSEHAT (Indonesia's national health data exchange platform). Contains Indonesian medical/clinical terms mapped to international standards (SNOMED-CT, ICD-10, LOINC). Includes anatomy, diseases, procedures, drugs, and clinical observations. Also see the SATUSEHAT FHIR R4 Implementation Guide for structured terminology.
access_method: Manual scrape of HTML page or use curl + parsing. No direct download; build your own extractor with BeautifulSoup/cheerio.

name: OJK Pedia - Financial & Banking Terminology (Otoritas Jasa Keuangan)
license: Indonesian Government open data (Otoritas Jasa Keuangan) - public information
description: Official Indonesian financial & banking terminology glossary from OJK (Financial Services Authority). Covers perbankan (banking), saham (stocks), obligasi (bonds), asuransi (insurance), investasi, fintech, kebijakan moneter, and related regulation. Critical for STT in finance/economy contexts (e.g. 'sukuk', 'repo', 'JIBOR', 'SBN').
access_method: Manual scrape of HTML page (ASP.NET page with multiple sub-pages). Government site allows free public access.

name: Wikipedia Indonesia Database Dump (idwiki)
entry_count: 600,000+ articles with millions of unique Indonesian words
description: Full Wikipedia Indonesian dump - the largest freely-available corpus of Indonesian text. Extract unique words with frequency counts using wikiextractor + word tokenizer. Use this to (1) find rare/specialized vocabulary (medicine, law, biology, geography, history), (2) build a frequency-based ranking for fuzzy match priority, (3) extract proper nouns (person names, places, organizations). For STT, you can extract named entities and domain-specific terms by category.
access_method: curl -O https://dumps.wikimedia.org/idwiki/latest/idwiki-latest-pages-articles-multistream.xml.bz2  (1.32GB, ~10-30 min download). Process with: bzip2 -d | WikiExtractor.py

name: Mozilla Common Voice Indonesian (id) - Speech + Transcripts
format: TSV + MP3 audio (HF datasets format, config 'id')
description: Crowd-sourced Indonesian speech + text transcripts from Mozilla Common Voice. Critical for STT/ASR fine-tuning (Whisper, Wav2Vec2). The transcript TSV contains 25K+ unique validated Indonesian sentences which can also serve as a high-quality text corpus for STT evaluation and language model training. 671 unique speakers. Useful for testing your auto-correct dict against real spoken Indonesian.
access_method: pip install datasets && datasets.load_dataset('mozilla-foundation/common_voice_17_0', 'id')  (HF datasets library handles download automatically)

name: List of Loanwords in Indonesian (Wikipedia)
description: Comprehensive list of Indonesian loanwords from Sanskrit, Tamil, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Portuguese, Dutch, English, and other languages. Organized by source language with original spelling and meaning. Critical for STT because loanwords often have non-standard spellings that confuse ASR (e.g. 'kualitas' from Dutch 'kwaliteit', 'telepon' from Dutch 'telefoon', 'kantor' from Dutch 'kantoor'). Use these to expand your _fixes dict for common pronunciation-based misspellings.

name: Indonesian NLP Resources Index (ailabtelkom + Wikidepia)
license: Varies per linked dataset (mostly MIT, CC, Apache)
description: Two complementary master indexes of Indonesian NLP resources maintained by Telkom AI Lab and Wikidepia. They catalog: KBBI scrapes, Kamus Alay (slang), POS-tagged corpora, NER datasets (NERGRIT), hate-speech/abusive-language detection, sentiment lexicons (InSet), IndoBERT/IndoBERTweet, Indosum (summarization), Indonesian-Cross-Lingual (Tatoeba), and many more. Use these as a starting point for any specialized Indonesian NLP need.
access_method: git clone https://github.com/ailabtelkom/id-NLP-resources.git && git clone https://github.com/Wikidepia/indonesian_datasets.git  (browsable online - just follow links)
